response.why: Attackers are now locked in: Kaito 6/7 and Enduring Curiosity 4/3 are tapped and attacking; Sheoldred stayed home (summoning sick). This is exactly the window I was waiting for. Animating Restless Reef now gives me a 4/4 deathtouch blocker — deathtouch kills through hexproof since blocking isn't targeting, so blocking Kaito with Reef destroys Kaito outright (the only way to ever kill it, since it's hexproof on its own turn and not even a creature on mine). I lose the Reef land in the trade, but removing a permanently-growing, unremovable hexproof threat is an excellent price, and I still have Floodpits Drowner free to chump Enduring Curiosity and take zero combat damage this turn.
response.plan: Animate Restless Reef now so it's available as a blocker, then block Kaito with the 4/4 deathtouch Reef (kills it permanently) and block Enduring Curiosity with Floodpits Drowner as a chump to prevent all damage this turn. This is the first real kill-shot on Kaito all game, worth losing the land for.

response.why: Double-blocking to remove both threats without taking any damage is clearly best: Restless Reef (4/4 deathtouch) blocks Kaito and kills it outright — the only way to ever remove Kaito given his hexproof/non-creature-on-my-turn interaction — while Floodpits Drowner chumps Enduring Curiosity, absorbing all 10 potential damage and keeping me at 21 life. I only lose the Reef land and the already-spent Drowner in exchange for permanently destroying Kaito. Letting Enduring Curiosity go unblocked while Reef kills Kaito is still good but needlessly eats 4 damage; not blocking Kaito at all forfeits the only kill window on it this game.
response.plan: Block Kaito with the animated Restless Reef (deathtouch trade, kills Kaito permanently) and block Enduring Curiosity with Floodpits Drowner as a pure chump to prevent all combat damage this turn. Accepting the loss of Restless Reef and Floodpits Drowner as the cost of removing Kaito for good.

Casting now costs nothing since I have no other spell to sequence around, and even nets a bonus card in some lines via Faerie Mastermind's symmetric draw ability.

After that I'm down to just Deep-Cavern Bat and need to draw into more threats/answers for Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Mastermind.

leaves.line: 1 block(s), response 1
leaves.our_board: no creatures | 5 lands (3 untapped)
leaves.opp_board: Enduring Curiosity 4/3 T, Deep-Cavern Bat 1/1 | 6 lands (0 untapped)

response.why: Deep-Cavern Bat has no real defensive value anyway (it can't meaningfully block the 4/3 Enduring Curiosity), so attacking is free value: either it connects for a point of damage and lifelink, or it trades evenly with one of their summoning-sick 1/1-2/1 flyers. Not attacking forfeits this for no benefit.
response.plan: Attack with Deep-Cavern Bat for chip damage/lifelink or an even trade with one of their small flyers. I'm at 10 life with no other creatures, so I need to keep drawing into blockers or removal for Enduring Curiosity and Faerie Mastermind.

response.why: At 5 life with an empty board, casting Enduring Curiosity (my only card) as a blocker is essential — every 'do nothing' branch under 'pass' leaves me with zero creatures facing down Kaito, Preacher, Enduring Curiosity, and Faerie Mastermind, which is close to lethal next turn. Casting it now guarantees the blocker is down regardless of what they do in response, while passing risks ending up in the worst-case branch where I never deploy it.
response.plan: Cast Enduring Curiosity now as a 4/3 blocker — it's my only resource and I'm nearly dead, so there's no benefit to holding it further since I have no other cards to sequence around. Will need to block whatever attacks it can profitably (likely chumping Kaito or trading with Preacher) to survive.

response.why: Nothing on the stack, no cards in hand — no meaningful action available at upkeep.
response.plan: At 5 life facing Kaito (7/8), Preacher (2/4 deathtouch), Enduring Curiosity (4/3), and Faerie Mastermind (2/1) with only one blocker (my own Enduring Curiosity), I likely cannot survive a full attack — total unblocked damage after any single block still exceeds my life total. I'll block the largest attacker I can to minimize damage in case they don't swing with everything, but I have no way to prevent lethal if they attack all-out.
